svg.text: PARENTCONNECT — Parent ERD: Deletion Notices and Account State
Parent-facing scheduled-deletion notices and the ICT approval record that controls the lifecycle
PK primary key UQ unique field ● required ○ nullable
Only parent_deletion_notifications directly belongs to the Parent experience; the ICT account is shown to complete the declared approval FK.
Every connector uses a private route and endpoint; no shared segments or T-junctions are used.
